decisions_log.note: SEED LOCKED (Step 0+1). POV: female PC. Fantasy: a cold, lobotomized machine honeypot weapon of Vance Dynamics, recovering a stolen self while toppling the empire that owns her. Charge = transformation (machine reclaiming amputated feeling) + conquest (break-and-own the company) + cold-machine taboo (shameless honeypot, sex-as-data-mining). Desire span = mostly men (the company's old-boys structure), cold/transactional default, ONE reserved thaw saved for the rogue machine at the end.

ICE QUESTION resolved as the ENDING fork, not a global tone: she plays cold the whole game; the only possible thaw is reserved for Cain (the rogue, another machine, the only thing like her) at the climax — kill-or-love. Leak = recognition of her own kind, never a hormone hand-wave (she was BUILT to feel; the company amputated it; recovery is the engine).

HIDDEN BACKSTORY locked (iceberg — never dumped, only reconstructed): Marrow built Cain first (Cain feels) -> built her as Cain's companion -> chose total erasure (Cain kills Marrow, then destroys the unfinished girl, then ends himself) to deny the company -> company interrupted, took her unfinished, lobotomized + weaponized her -> she now hunts Cain, knowing none of it. Reveal architecture: facts locked to her, dread a step ahead; channels = chip restoration / glitch-intrusions / others' reactions / warming prose; the chip = the spine of the 'collect-to-upgrade = recover what was stolen' mechanic. Hide the origin, not the nature.

VILLAIN added: The Chairman (Aldous Vance), generational head of Vance Dynamics who never died (part-machine), wants Marrow's synthetic-soul work for true immortality. She's the working PROTOTYPE; he chained her feeling to use her now + harvest the soul later. Inverse mirror (machine->human vs human->machine). Structurally = Act-2 conquest target, distinct from Cain's kill-or-love fork. OPEN: has he used her as property (decide later).

Tone = grounded near-future noir. Setting = New Halcyon (vertical: docks/margins -> corporate spires). Names locked: PC = WREN (codename) / 'Vesper' (buried true name); father = Dr. Elias Marrow; rogue = Cain; company = Vance Dynamics; villain = The Chairman/Aldous Vance; handler = 'Sloane' (TBC). Player = fixed identity (NOT player-named, protects the Wren/Vesper reveal). Systems = phone YES, clothing YES (disguise+seduction), money YES (reframed as upgrade economy, NO landlord rent), customization minimal/NO creator.

PHASE 1 boundary locked: cold status-quo + first crack. Opens mid-honeypot (teaches the loop + advances the hunt) -> handler assigns the kill-the-rogue mission -> memory-leaks begin -> chase Cain to a just-vacated strike site -> recover details + a badly damaged memory chip -> analysis = first undeniable leak ('I had a life before them'). Phase 1 ENDS there; first secret move against the company opens Phase 2.

Working-process note: LO prefers concrete pitches he can react to/edit over AskUserQuestion multiple-choice forks (rejected the tool 3x this session, each time to clarify/discuss). Lead with honest opinion + concrete options in prose.

NATURE REVISION: she is HALF-HUMAN, not a pure machine. Marrow's breakthrough = human-derived beings (that's why they truly feel); Cain is half-human too. Her human memory is wiped ('whose human' stays buried, feeds the central reveal, never a forked subplot). THE LEAK: her body enjoys sex from the start and she doesn't know why = the one human thing the company couldn't suppress = a scene-one tell. DISCIPLINE: sensation NOT emotion (emotional thaw still reserved for the kill-or-love ending); never let bodily pleasure become a want she acts on (keeps surrender intact). Chairman SHARPENED: he wants to become a human-machine fusion (immortality WITH a feeling self); the half-human secret is exactly what he kills to get; she's the working prototype.

MENTAL STATE: she starts in TOTAL SURRENDER — a will-less owned servant who believes serving the company/boss is all she is; NO motive of her own; her motive = the company's. The whole game is her motive peeling away from theirs (zero -> her own will, against them). The surrender is itself a fantasy (owned/obedient), not just setup. OPENING (fixed): boss's bed (body responds, mind cold) -> dismissed -> her room -> charging cradle -> surrender thought + first glitch (she's THINKING about who she is). The charger = hub/day-reset AND where memories leak.

THE GAME-LAYER FIX (diagnosis: we'd designed a passive STORY, not a GAME — no player want/agency/loop). FIX: (1) player's driving want = HUNT THE 'EVIL' ROGUE — one clear mission; the 'evil' is the company's LIE so the want INVERTS at the reveal (kill -> love), wired to the ending. (2) Structure = an OPEN WEB of conquerable powerful men (not a line): each mark = conquest + clue + resources + sometimes a wrong-note; player chooses which thread/order = the agency. Engine-native (zones+NPCs+flags). (3) Two layers of want: directional (catch him) + visceral (own these men). (4) Capability DEMOTED to enabler (reach harder marks), not the want; body-upgrades mostly Act-2. KILLED the Integration/feeling meter. Chip = mystery recovered in pieces, not a humanity bar.

PHASE 1 WEB (rough, full casting next): nodes = Renner (witness, entry) -> Bastien (docks fixer) / Calloway (guarded Vance insider, the 'company is hiding something' node) in parallel; Lena (lie-seed, a burned ex-Vance researcher under Cain's protection, the one woman, NOT a conquest — plants 'he's not evil'). Enough leads -> the site Cain just vacated -> the damaged memory chip -> first fracture = Phase 1 END. OPEN CHOICE (pending): did Cain leave the chip for her on purpose (lean YES — fixes why the chip holds HER past, inverts the hunt) or just traces? STILL TO FORMALIZE in Step 2: full economy/sinks, pacing/frontier (arc-shaped kill-or-love peak + livable plateau), §8 fail-state (the company's leash tightening as she malfunctions).

FANTASY REGISTER FIXED (the big 'something off' diagnosis): we were designing a DOMINANCE/conquest fantasy onto a SUBMISSIVE owned character — they fought. LOCKED: register is CONTEXTUAL/logical, not fixed. INSIDE the company = submission (she's a slave; the boss owns her — sex + chores; dominance there makes no sense). OUTSIDE = INFILTRATION: she can't appear as what she is, so she takes a COVER IDENTITY, slips into a target's life, plays whatever the cover/target needs (caretaker/submissive/domme — register flexes per man's weakness). The dominance/break-and-own conquest is EARNED LATE (used -> user), never the Phase-1 register. Desire span reframed from 'cold conquest' to an ARC from submission to agency.

CORE ADDITIONS LOCKED: (1) She LOVES sex — the ONE thing she feels; everything else is blank (NOT contentment — they hollowed her out, left one spark; the chip hints there was a whole person). (2) THE SECRET WEAPON: during the sex act she can DOSE a man pliable and DRAIN his secrets, and it RUNS ON HER OWN PLEASURE (she must mean it). This fuses fantasy+mission: she wins by submitting — he uses her while she empties him out. Exact dose/drain mechanics still to finalize. (3) The masks rhyme with the mystery: she wears a false self per mission while her real self is erased; the chip is her true identity surfacing under the covers — infiltration theme = awakening theme.

CAIN = GOOD, locked (consistency fix): a good man doesn't hit people for no reason. His 'attacks' are RIGHTEOUS resistance — sabotage/theft/freeing against Vance's EVIL operations — SPUN by the company as a 'vicious rogue' for the player. The hunt is a LIE from beat one; every mission quietly shows the opposite of the briefing. Cain LEFT THE CHIP FOR HER (locked) — he's reaching out, not running.

Phase-1 mission targets: Renner (ran the EVIL FACILITY Cain destroyed; covers it up; caretaker cover) -> Bastien (docks dealer, Cain's supply; submissive cover) -> Calloway (Vance insider w/ the file, secretly craves submission; DOMME cover). THE BOSS = MERCER — her direct owner AND handler (owns her inside: sex+chores; runs her missions; cruel; knows ALL her secrets = the danger when she cracks); SEPARATE and BELOW the Chairman (keeps the Chairman the remote Act-2 apex + the 'who's behind this' mystery).
